name: OpenAI Frontier Evals
summary: OpenAI's open-source code for frontier capability evals: PaperBench, SWE-Lancer and EVMbench.
description: PaperBench measures end-to-end replication of state-of-the-art AI papers, SWE-Lancer uses real freelance software-engineering tasks with end-to-end tests, and EVMbench covers smart-contract security tasks. Each suite has its own README and a uv-managed environment (`uv sync`). MIT. Last commit October 2026.
